recipes.title: Mango Cream Mochi

items.i: toasted cornstarch or glutinous rice flour, for dusting

steps: Whisk the glutinous rice flour, cornstarch, sugar and milk into a smooth batter and strain it into a heatproof bowl.
Cover and steam for about 20 minutes, stirring once halfway, until the dough is translucent and cooked through.
While warm, knead in the butter until smooth and stretchy (wear gloves). Let it cool, then chill until firm enough to handle.
Whip the cold cream with the sugar to stiff peaks and spoon into a piping bag.
Divide the dough into 6 pieces. On a surface dusted with toasted cornstarch, roll each into a thin round.

Pipe a swirl of cream into the center of each round, add mango cubes, pipe a little more cream on top, then gather the edges, pinch to seal and place seam-side down in paper cups. Chill before serving.
recipes.notes: Estimated recipe: the video is silent with no amounts (the full written recipe is on the creator's site, u-taste.com), so quantities, times and macros are estimates for a standard mango cream mochi.
